pages.text: Raw Quartz Clusters are a light source. They can be collected with a pick bearing the Silk Touch enchantment; otherwise breaking a Raw Quartz Cluster will return a piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/rawquartz)Raw Radiant Quartz$(/l).
Infusion Matrix Raw Quartz Clusters can be used as an infusion stabilizer.
Raw Quartz Clusters are created over time on top of a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/radiantresonator)Radiant Resonator$(/l).
